Subject: POC trial plan: deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - Acme Corp

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can scope the pilot: 

Call recap / key notes
- Primary goal: validate query latency and cost at your 200 qps baseline for customer-facing search (embedding + rerank).
- Data sensitivity: some PII in content ranking; security wants isolation options.
- Ops: procurement needs estimated monthly cost for budgeting.

Deployment mode considerations (from our side)
- Hosted API: fastest to start, minimal setup, shared capacity; good if isolation isn't required and you want quickest time-to-value.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools we can size to meet your 200 qps SLO with predictable unit costs and stronger isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): recommended only if you need full network isolation, customer-managed infra, or strict regulatory controls (longer lead time).

Proposed POC / trial plan (high level)
1) Scope: evaluate latency (p95 & p99) and cost at 200 qps for a 2-week sustained window, and run a set of 5000 representative queries from your production sample.
2) Success criteria (examples): p95 < 200ms for 99% of queries; cost per 1k requests within budget target (we'll fill number after sizing); no data exfiltration for test dataset.
3) Timeline: target pilot start window = June 8–22 (2 weeks).
4) Stakeholders: Sam (product), Priya (security), your CTO/infra, Redwood: me (AE), Marissa (solutions), Dev (SRE/SE).

Attachments: POC-plan-template.pdf, redwood-deployment-matrix.xlsx (initial sizing & tradeoffs).

Could you confirm: 1) whether you prefer Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted as the primary candidate for the pilot, 2) an initial target start date in June, and 3) any mandatory security checklist items for the pilot?

If Dedicated is preferred, we can send an initial sizing and cost estimate upfront and schedule a technical deep dive with your infra/security team.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

Ben —

Appreciate the thorough recap. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Deployment preference: leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the pilot so we can test predictable performance and keep tenant-level isolation. Private VPC is something our security team will push for in production, but the lead time looks long for the pilot.
2) Timeline: June 14 start would work better for us (internal calendar + procurement approvals). Two weeks sounds right for initial validation.
3) Security checklist: Priya (cc) will send the SOC 2 and encryption requirements; for the pilot we need network isolation (VPC peering) and access to audit logs. Also need an NDA addendum for test data with PII.

Stakeholders to include:
- Me (Sam) — Product owner
- Priya Shah — Security (cc)
- Arjun Patel — CTO (will join the technical deep dive)
- Maya Gomez — Procurement (for cost sign-off)

Please send a dedicated sizing / cost estimate and we can loop procurement. Also can you confirm high-level pricing tiers for Dedicated? If possible, include a bump-free tier for the pilot (short trial commitment).

Thanks,
Sam
